# Wayon Cloud AI access

Wayon exposes owner-authorized, read-only vehicle and comma telemetry.

- System prompt: /wayon-ai-prompt.md
- OpenAPI: /wayon-ai-openapi.json
- API base: /api/ai
- Authentication: Authorization: Bearer WAYON_AI_READ_TOKEN

Data includes telemetry freshness, driving state, location, speed, OpenPilot state,
vehicle voltage/current/estimated input power, comma power draw, numeric device
temperatures, trips, lock events, offroad impacts, and authorized impact images.

The API has no write, SSH, update, or vehicle-control operation.
